People: Charles Codrington Pressick Hobkirk (author, Wikidata Q21515876), died 1902. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Hobkirk, Charles C. P. (Charles Codrington Pressick), 1837-1902") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: A synopsis of the British mosses, containing descriptions of all the genera and species, (with localities of the rarer ones) found in Great Britain and Ireland, based upon Wilson's "Bryologia britannica," Schimper's "Synopsis," etc, London, L. Reeve, 1873, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/synopsisofbritis00hobk. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 46%, 60%, 86% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Charles Codrington Pressick Hobkirk, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
